column3: “Taunt you” is supplied to the lament; the recipient of the fields is singular in Hebrew.
“Divide the land” interprets casting a measuring line by lot.
“Will not overtake us” interprets the statement that disgrace does not withdraw; “us” is supplied.
“Impatient” interprets the shortness of the spirit.
“Like” is supplied before the returning warriors.
“Surely” is not repeated before collecting; “a noisy throng” compresses the clause about noise from people.
